sourceMechanismEvidence.interpretation: selected-case mechanism evidence only; acceptance cases use a fresh seed

candidate.name: high-consequence-known-double-confirmation-v1
candidate.eligibility: an answered item has known-supporting evidence and its occurrence count alone exceeds the target miss-mass budget
candidate.confirmationTiming: after the natural assessment path and before final deck publication
candidate.independentArm: draw occasion-1 evidence from the frozen response model using an independent deterministic seed
candidate.fullyCorrelatedArm: reuse the original evidence as a negative control
candidate.selectionRule: retain the production deck; additionally select an eligible item when its confirmation is missing, excluded, or does not support known

decisionRule.failureAction: retain adverse evidence; do not tune occurrence eligibility or confirmation semantics from this run
